title: Flooring Installation in Davenport and Kissimmee: What to Expect
metaTitle: Flooring Installation in Davenport and Kissimmee: What to Expect
contentHtml:
If you're planning new floors in Davenport, Kissimmee, or a nearby town, you probably want to know what the job looks like from start to finish. Here's how it works with New Design Pro.

Where we work

We're a family business based in Davenport, FL. We serve homeowners across Polk and Osceola counties, including Davenport, Kissimmee, Haines City, Winter Haven, Lakeland, and Clermont.

How a job runs

  1. Free in-home measure. We come to your home, measure each room, and bring Duralast samples so you can see them in your own light.
  2. Choose your floor. You can preview our floors on our website and compare samples at home before you decide.
  3. Subfloor prep. We level and prep the subfloor before a single plank goes down. This is the step that decides how the floor lasts.
  4. Installation. Duralast SPC planks go down over the prepared floor.
  5. Finish. We add clean transitions and baseboards so the job looks complete.

See real work first

We share real job photos from Central Florida homes, so you can see the work before you commit.

Next step

Book a free in-home measure. We'll come to your home, measure the space, and bring samples.

New Design Pro is a family business with installers who each bring 10+ years on the tools. We'd like to earn your floor.

Call (561) 809-3864 or request your free in-home measure at newdesignpro.com.
